memberdef.name: onStop

briefdescription.para: Runs the drain for the stored stop reason, and returns the DAP messages it builds.

detaileddescription.para: Processor::process calls it on each pass of the engine context. A stop reason of none gives no messages.

parameterdescription.para: Program path of a launch. Empty for an attach.

simplesect.para: DAP messages to send, in order. Empty when no drain runs.

briefdescription.para: Turns each stop of the target into DAP messages.

detaileddescription.para: The session fires the stop events. The handlers that StopManager registers store the stop reason in the model, and most of them also store the execution state. onStop then runs the drain for the stored reason. A drain returns the DAP messages to send.
